faces.note: The upper face: 2.5 m short of the plateau, the water falls from its brink.
The lower face: its top is the lip of the lower fall; the shelf's stream keeps its banks.
The lower step past the west end of its face.
The lower step past the east end of its face.
The west bank of the cove the lower fall lands in.
The east bank of the cove: the wall of the mill's bench, level with its floor all along.
The upper step past the east end of its face, no further forward than that face.
The upper step past the west end of its face, no further forward than that face.
